 Shopping for Christmas? Xiaomi’s 11.11 Sale Has Something for Everyone on Your List
 Deals 
 November 10, 2026 
 Regine Tan 
 Christmas shopping can get a little overwhelming when you have several people to buy gifts for, each with their own interests and everyday needs. You might have a family member who’s always looking for the latest gadgets, a friend who’s always listening to music, or someone at home who would appreciate a new appliance. Finding something they’ll actually use can take a bit of thought, especially when you’re working with a budget. 
 If you’re still figuring out what to get everyone this year, Xiaomi Philippines has several options worth checking out. Its 11.11 sale features discounts on smartphones, tablets, wearables, smart home devices, and other everyday tech essentials across Xiaomi, REDMI, and POCO .  
 From gadgets for students and fitness enthusiasts to practical finds for the household, here are some Xiaomi tech gift ideas to add to your Christmas list. 
 1. For the Person Who’s Always on Their Phone 
 Photo: Xiaomi
 A new smartphone is a practical gift for someone who relies on their device throughout the day. From messaging and browsing to taking photos and watching videos, having a phone that can handle everyday activities makes a difference. 
 For everyday users, the REDMI 17 (4GB+128GB) is worth considering. It features a 7,500mAh battery, a 6.9-inch display, and a 50MP AI dual camera system. Originally priced at ₱12,999, it will be available for ₱11,999 during the sale. 
 Those looking for another option can check out the REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G (6GB+256GB) , which highlights the series’ Titan Durability features. It will be available for ₱22,999 , down from ₱24,999. 
 POCO also has several smartphone options in its 11.11 lineup. The POCO C95 Pro starts at ₱10,999 for the 6GB+128GB variant and ₱12,999 for the 8GB+256GB variant. The POCO X6 starts at ₱21,999, while the POCO X8s starts at ₱22,999. For those considering a premium smartphone gift, the POCO F8 Ultra is available for ₱41,999 for the 12GB+256GB variant and ₱44,999 for the 16GB+512GB variant. 
 2. For Students, Creatives, and Those Who Love Getting Things Done on a Tablet 
 Photo: Xiaomi
 Know someone who spends a lot of time studying, working on projects, or watching their favorite shows? A tablet can be a useful addition to their daily routine, especially for those who prefer having a larger screen for reading, streaming, and managing tasks. 
 The Xiaomi Pad 7 (8GB+128GB) is one option to consider. Suitable for studying, entertainment, and productivity, it will be available for ₱18,999 , down from ₱25,999. 
 Another option is the Xiaomi Pad 8 (8GB+128GB) , which will be offered for ₱21,999 , reduced from ₱26,499. Both tablets offer a convenient way to enjoy content and handle everyday tasks on a larger display. 
 3. For Your Fitness-Obsessed Friend or Bestie Who’s Always Listening to Music 
 Photo: Xiaomi
 If you have a friend who likes tracking their daily activities or rarely goes anywhere without their favorite playlist, a wearable and audio bundle could be a thoughtful gift. 
 Through its Lazada Bundle Deals, Xiaomi is offering the Xiaomi Smart Band 9 Active and REDMI Buds 6 Active Bundle for ₱1,999 , down from ₱2,528. The combination brings together everyday activity tracking and wireless audio, making it a useful pairing for someone who enjoys staying active. 
 For those who prefer a smartwatch, there’s also the REDMI Watch 5 and REDMI Buds 6 Active Bundle , available for ₱5,299 , down from ₱6,328. Both bundles come with a Xiaomi Mi Casual Daypack, adding another everyday item to the gift package. 
 4. For the Family Who Never Misses Movie Night 
 Photo: Xiaomi
 A television can be a bigger Christmas gift, especially for a family that likes gathering in the living room for movies and shows. It’s also a household addition that everyone can make use of long after the holidays. 
 The Xiaomi TV A 55 (2026) will be available for ₱19,999, down from ₱22,690, during Xiaomi’s Shopee-exclusive 11.11 offers. It’s worth considering if you’re planning to get your family a new television for their shared living space. 
 5. For Someone Who Would Appreciate a Little Help Around the House 
 Photo: Xiaomi
 Some people genuinely appreciate receiving appliances as gifts, especially when these are items they can use regularly. If you’re shopping for a parent, a family member, or someone setting up a home, Xiaomi’s home appliance deals have a few options to consider. 
 The Mijia Front Load Washer 9kg will be available for ₱19,999 , down from ₱20,999. It’s a practical household purchase for families who could use a new washing machine. 
 You can also look into Xiaomi’s air care options. The Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 Plus will be priced at ₱18,999, while the Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 EU will be available for ₱11,499. 
 These products are part of Xiaomi’s Shopee-exclusive 11.11 home appliance offers, so you can check the participating online store for more details. 
 6. For the Friend Who’s Investing in Smart Home Gadgets 
 Photo: Xiaomi
 Have someone on your gift list who’s always interested in connected devices and home technology? Xiaomi’s Lazada-exclusive AIoT bundles bring together products for air care and home monitoring, offering a few options for anyone looking to add smart devices to their home. 
 For air care, the Air Care Bundle 1 includes the Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Compact and Xiaomi Humidifier 2 Lite. It will be available for ₱5,299 , down from ₱6,948. 
 Another option is Air Care Bundle 2 , which combines the Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Lite and Xiaomi Smart Humidifier 2 for ₱9,998 , reduced from ₱11,048. 
 For someone interested in home monitoring, Xiaomi also has two security bundles. Security Bundle 1 pairs the Xiaomi Smart Camera C100 with the Outdoor Camera CW100 Dual for ₱3,578 , down from ₱4,848. Meanwhile, Security Bundle 2 features the Xiaomi Smart Camera C301 and Outdoor Camera CW300, available for ₱4,298 , down from ₱6,148. 
 Each of these AIoT bundles also comes with a Xiaomi Mi Casual Daypack. 
 7. For the Friend Who Always Needs a Charger 
 Photo: Xiaomi
 If you’re looking for a smaller gift or something to add to a Christmas gift set, a power bank is an easy-to-appreciate option. It’s particularly useful for people who spend a lot of time outside, commute regularly, or rely on their phones throughout the day. 
 Xiaomi is offering two 10,000mAh Power Banks for ₱1,999 through its Shopee-exclusive 11.11 deals. It’s a practical accessory to consider for friends and family who could use an extra charging option while on the go. 
 Start Your Christmas Shopping Early With Xiaomi’s 11.11 Sale 
 Shopping for several people can add up, so looking through different price points and product categories can help you plan your Christmas budget. Xiaomi’s 11.11 sale has options ranging from smaller everyday accessories to smartphones, tablets, wearables, and household appliances, giving you plenty to consider as you work through your gift list. 
 You can find Xiaomi’s smartphone and tablet deals through its participating official online stores, with select home appliances and AIoT bundles available through Shopee and Lazada-exclusive offers. Promotional prices, product availability, and bundled offers are subject to applicable terms and conditions. 
 Have you started shopping for Christmas gifts yet? Which of these Xiaomi gadgets would you add to your list, or perhaps give to someone special this holiday season? 
 Shop Xiaomi’s 11.11 deals on Shopee and Lazada to find great tech gifts for everyone on your Christmas list.
